# Northern Solar — From Roof to Grid: Commercial Solar Setup in Malaysia
URL: https://northernsolar.com.my/from-roof-to-grid-commercial-solar-setup-in-malaysia/
Date captured: 2026-08-11

## Step-by-Step Commercial Solar Installation
| Phase | Key Activities | Duration | Deliverables / Approvals |
| Assessment | Roof check and energy analysis | 2–4 weeks | Feasibility report |
| Design | Panel, inverter selection | 1–2 weeks | Design & approvals |
| Procurement & Mounting | Equipment purchase & installation | 2–3 weeks | Installed system |
| Commissioning | Performance & safety tests | 1 week | Test reports |
| Grid Approval | Submit documents for TNB approval | 2–4 weeks | Connection permit |
| Activation | System goes live | Immediate | Operational system |

## Assessing Roof Space, Energy Load & Local Regulations
Factors: Roof & Orientation (usable area, sunlight -> max panel capacity); Structure (roof strength/safety -> durability); Shading (obstructions -> production); Energy Use (daytime profile -> sizing); Compliance (SEDA & TNB -> grid approval).

## Designing the System
- Solar Panels: certified suppliers, sized for roof and demand.
- Inverters: DC->AC, configured to TNB voltage/frequency/export limits; settings critical for grid approval.
- Wiring & Safety: quality cables/isolators, surge protection, grounding per Malaysian codes.

## Procurement, Mounting, Commissioning & Grid Connection
| Stage | Duration | Outcome |
| Procurement | 1–2 weeks | Equipment delivered |
| Mounting | 1–3 weeks | Installed system |
| Commissioning | 1 week | Certification |
| Documentation | 2–4 weeks | Connection approved |
| Connection | Immediate | Live system |
Grid connection governed by formal inspection; TNB verifies protection devices, inverter behaviour, system output. Surplus exported and credited under NEM.

## Cost and ROI
Commercial installs RM100,000–RM500,000; payback 5–8 years (sometimes 3). Capital covers panels (certified vendors), inverters, mounting, labor, testing, grid approval fees. Savings from reduced bills + NEM export credits over 20–25 yr lifespan.

## Choosing a Provider
EPCC responsible for engineering accuracy, procurement control, construction quality, approval coordination. Assess safety record, past projects, financing options. Familiarity with SEDA guidelines reduces regulatory risk and speeds approval.

## Maintenance and Warranty
Output declines without active monitoring/maintenance. Annual cleaning, inspections, real-time monitoring. Equipment warranties (panels/inverters) + service agreements (inspections, testing, fault response).

## Notes from related articles (Jul/Aug 2026)
- Malaysia Carbon Tax 2026 increases operating costs for export manufacturers on grid power; on-site solar is a hedge.
- PETRA warned at SuRIA Home launch: blacklisted providers take their submitted rebate claims down with them, including compliant clients.
